Tiger Woods’s athletic career is over. His job is to be a dad now. I hope he gets the help he needs because I’d like to see him waiting for his son on the 18th green at the US Open one day.

Video

How many teams employ people charged with or convicted of felonies or significant misdemeanors? If this is truly just based on his opinions, the NBA player’s union should be defending him like crazy. Bad precedent.


Shams Charania (@ShamsCharania)

The Chicago Bulls are waiving guard Jaden Ivey after his recent anti-LGBTQ comments amid several rants on religion and other topics, sources tell ESPN.

I think Trump’s 2024 win was the incentive to start cleaning house. There was joy in the executive offices when Elle Duncan left, if someone would hire away Ryan Clark too I think they’d break out champagne flutes and put on ski goggles to celebrate.

ESPN is largely abandoning far left wing sports commentators, either firing them or letting their contracts expire. This is a smart move by new leadership. Good piece from @burackbobby_ on the continued collapse of woke sports: outkick.com/analysis/espn-sl…

It’s insane that this is considered partisan. Everyone is for this except for Democrats, who used to be for this too, until they realized it made cheating harder.
